ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DCOM InternetExplorer.Application DLL Hijack - Image Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL hijack of "iertutil.dll" found in the DCOM InternetExplorer.Application Class Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Internet\\ Explorer\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Internet\\ Explorer\\\\iertutil\\\.dll$"))
